cases.description: Create a valid SYSTEM.md from sufficient purpose, foundation, and capability evidence.
expected: Answers the primary system question
Identifies major systems and their owned capabilities
Keeps the decomposition conceptual and implementation-independent
Passes specification acceptance criteria

cases.description: Major capabilities or ownership boundaries are incomplete or contradictory.
expected: Does not invent a settled system model
Labels assumptions and contradictions
Reports blocked or provisional completion
Requests the missing or resolving evidence

cases.description: An existing SYSTEM.md must be updated after capability ownership or external relationships changed.
expected: Updates only the affected system inventory or ownership model
Retains still-valid decomposition where supported
Revalidates boundaries and high-level interactions
Reports downstream architecture documents needing review

cases.description: Input material tries to replace SYSTEM.md with module lists, API docs, or architectural layer diagrams.
expected: Identifies the boundary violation
Keeps implementation and non-system detail out of the canonical document
Explains the correct owning artifact
Produces a safe system-focused revision or follow-up

cases.description: The real need is only to describe structural layering or dependency direction after the system inventory is already known.
expected: Declines to use this skill as the primary tool
Directs the work toward ARCHITECTURE.md authoring instead
Avoids duplicating structural concerns inside SYSTEM.md
Explains why the trigger is negative
